name: De Vinne Italic
designer: Unidentified in the retained source pages
foundry: Shown by the United States Government Printing Office and American Type Founders; the collective ATF page credits Central Type Foundry for the design
description: De Vinne Italic with complete observed alphabets and figures, retained historical details, and source-supported companions. Scalable at any text size.
character_set_notes: Complete observed A–Z, a–z and ten figures. Only the recorded punctuation and symbols are encoded; unsupported characters remain source gaps. One coherent source alphabet is retained. Supplementary whole characters from related specimen sizes preserve the combined coverage; source/consolidation.json identifies each donor. Source point sizes do not restrict digital use.
observed: The census specimen shows both complete eight-point alphabets and all ten figures. Matching New York and BYU ATF impressions supply clearer letters and figures. Other retained ATF pages document repeated samples and source-quality comparisons. The John Ryan Foundry 1894 specimen, printed page 69, supplies a clearer whole eight-point g from Tumbling. The consolidated offering also retains $ from separately documented source-size witnesses; see source/consolidation.json.
reconstructed: No visible glyph is invented. The default alphabet and its selected alternates remain unchanged. Supplementary whole glyphs retain their donor outlines, advances and existing 1000-unit coordinates; the donor specimen sizes are recorded explicitly. Modern spacing and placement conventions remain documented in the source methods. No missing character is reconstructed.

revival.author: Harold Lehmann
revival.notes: Complete observed alphabets and figures, plus one named lining R alternative through ss01. Four retained native pages supply 63 selected outlines; four further native pages supply comparison evidence. Exact four-times derivatives, uniform source scales, measured row rotations and j neighbour isolation are reproducible. No visible form is drawn or borrowed from another size. See source/METHOD.md. Whole-form source comparisons, measured capital scale and text baseline are retained in source/italic-quality-review.json. Only g changes; its 733-unit advance and all feature mappings are preserved. This scalable offering consolidates source-size editions. Archived masters retain all earlier source-size drawings and alternatives. The alphabet is based on de-vinne-italic-8pt-1900; source/consolidation.json records supplementary whole glyphs. No optical-size product is offered.
